nodes.label: NOXES Signal Mark (symbol / app icon)
nodes.content: Standalone square NOXES symbol (SVG, viewBox 128x128) suited to an app icon, favicon, or avatar. A graphite (#414548) four-corner bracket frame with square caps and stroke-width 6 surrounds a vermilion (#E83708) abstract 'N' / signal stroke (M39 87V41l50 46V41, stroke-width 9, square caps, miter joins) with a filled vermilion dot at (89,41). Accessible via role=img with title 'NOXES signal mark' and desc 'NOXES vermilion signal mark with graphite frame.'
